content: Hello! how can I help today?
I opened a bank account in Germany. Do I need to tell the IRS?

Yes. If the total of all your foreign financial accounts exceeds $10,000 **at any point in the year**, you must file the **FBAR (FinCEN Form 114)**.

It’s separate from your tax return and due April 15, with an automatic extension to October.
It’s filed electronically at **bsaefiling.fincen.treas.gov**. Do not mail it to the IRS—it’s a FinCEN filing under the Bank Secrecy Act.
Do I report account activity or just balances?
Only report the **maximum value** during the year—not activity. Convert to USD using the year-end Treasury exchange rate. You’ll need account numbers, institutions, and peak balances.
Is there a penalty for not filing?
Yes. Civil penalties can be up to **$10,000 per violation** for non-willful errors—and much higher for willful noncompliance. Always file if thresholds are met.
